tex_content.html: Assume, for some $C>0$, \[ |L(p,z,x)|\leq C(|p|^q+|z|^q+1), \tag {35} \] and \[ \begin{cases} |D_pL(p,z,x)|\leq C(|p|^{q-1}+|z|^{q-1}+1),\\ |D_zL(p,z,x)|\leq C(|p|^{q-1}+|z|^{q-1}+1) \end{cases} \tag {36} \] for $p\in \R ^n$, $z\in \R $, and $x\in U$. The associated boundary-value problem is \[ \begin{cases} -\displaystyle \sum _{i=1}^n(L_{p_i}(Du,u,x))_{x_i}+L_z(Du,u,x)=0 & \text{in }U,\\ u=g & \text{on }\partial U. \end{cases} \tag {37} \]
